message.content: [罪名]虚开增值税普通发票罪<eoa>
message.reasoning_content:
need to identify crimes based on facts: The defendant Wang contracted a construction project, to settle payment he had someone help him to "虚开" (falsely issue) a VAT ordinary invoice (增值税普通发票) for 1,257,814.95 RMB, paying 37,000 RMB for "开票费". This is false invoicing. Under Chinese criminal law, the crime is "虚开增值税普通发票罪" (crime of falsifying VAT ordinary invoices). Also possibly "骗取增值税专用发票" but here it's ordinary invoice. The law: Article 205 of Criminal Law (formerly) for "虚开增值税专用发票、普通发票罪". So the appropriate charge: "虚开增值税普通发票罪". Could also be "非法经营罪"? No. The fact only supports that crime. Also maybe "逃税罪"? Not indicated; they didn't evade tax, they just falsified invoice for settlement. So single crime.

Thus answer: [罪名]虚开增值税普通发票罪<eoa>
